name: Acyclic Orientation Square Defect
definition: For a nonempty finite partial cube $H$, let $f_2(H)$ be its number of contained squares. For an acyclic orientation $O$ of its one-inclusion graph, put $\varepsilon_H(O)=\sum_{v\in H}\binom{d_O^+(v)}2-f_2(H)$, and define $\mu(H)=\min_O\varepsilon_H(O)$. For a specified vertex $a$, the rooted value $\mu(H,a)$ minimizes over acyclic orientations having $a$ as a sink.
parameters: The rooted variant has a distinguished sink vertex $a$.
normalization: Squares are contained two-dimensional cube faces, and $d_O^+(v)$ is outdegree in the oriented one-inclusion graph.
comments: The score $\varepsilon_H(O)$ belongs to an oriented realization; minimizing over all acyclic orientations gives the graph invariant. Transporting a particular order through a contraction need not make its score nonincreasing.
